1D6K9TRC7yPb2YfFvRvauc.name: Ghost Notes
1D6K9TRC7yPb2YfFvRvauc.summary:
Ghost Notes is a collaboration with producer and multi-instrumentalist Florian Fourlin, expanding on the distinctive saxophone textures first heard in Liminal Hotel. Inspired by the expressive, left-field playing of artists like Sam Gendel, this collection explores the saxophone as a source of colour, movement and atmosphere as much as melody.

Full of soft, intimate tones shaped with tape echo, distortion and spacious reverbs, alongside decorative trills, pitch-shifted textures and evolving performances that come alive on the modwheel. From subtle embellishments to abstract, expressive layers, Ghost Notes is built for modern production, ambient composition and anyone looking to push the saxophone beyond its traditional role.

1TsIqOIuMeXGyf41AVwACH.name: Near Dark Garage
1TsIqOIuMeXGyf41AVwACH.summary:
Near Dark Garage is a love letter to the shadowy world of mid-2000s UK garage. Inspired by rain-soaked streets, empty night buses, and the haunting productions of artists like Burial, this collection blends gritty field recordings captured around Camden with filtered synths, ghostly textures, and weighty, late-night rhythms.

Inside you’ll find atmospheric pads, angelic textures, and a collection of beautifully swung drum loops that capture the space between garage, ambient electronica, and modern club music. Equal parts intimate and industrial, Near Dark Garage is built for producers chasing that unmistakable feeling of London’s after-hours soundtrack.

Made in collaboration with Shannen SP — a London-based curator and DJ with deep ties to the South African music scene — we brought together three powerhouse artists (Major League Djz, Jay Music and MDU aka TRP) in Johannesburg to capture the instrumentation that defines it.

Originating in the streets of Johannesburg and now occupying global stages, our new collection captures the genre’s vibrant energy through its head-bopping basslines, singular synths and the unmistakable log drum — allowing you to make eclectic tracks right off the bat.

3V8uEbpMHfMf5GyF8Ya0Qk.name: Abe Laboriel Jr. Drums
3V8uEbpMHfMf5GyF8Ya0Qk.summary: A bespoke drum kit performed by Abe Laboriel Jr. — best known as Sir Paul McCartney’s touring drummer since 2001. Brand new recordings, expertly captured at the iconic Henson Studios, Los Angeles. A versatile selection of highly detailed single hits, offering complete control of the character of a groove across a wide dynamic range. Suited to a range of styles, including pop, soul, funk and rock.

5OfQ7aecKM5p8F0Ck9yNo1.name: Synthwave
5OfQ7aecKM5p8F0Ck9yNo1.summary:
Synthwave is a collection of classic analogue-inspired synth sounds built for the unmistakable sound of the 80s. From lush pads and punchy plucks to nostalgic digital keys and retro leads, this pack captures the warmth, colour and optimism of a defining era in electronic music.

Inspired by the cinematic soundscapes of Vangelis and the timeless production of 80s pop, Synthwave is perfect for everything from synth-driven soundtracks to modern productions looking for a touch of vintage character. Whether you’re writing soaring melodies or shimmering accompaniment, these sounds bring instant retro atmosphere with a contemporary workflow.

EVjjLTeaP78k9oYPpWzwg.name: Gamelan Textures
EVjjLTeaP78k9oYPpWzwg.summary:
Gamelan Textures explores the rich sonic world of the Balinese gamelan through a collection of extended performance techniques and contemporary sound design. Featuring jegog, gender, barangan, reyong, and gongs, these instruments were performed by Andy Channing, Benoît Parmentier, members of Sekar Lukes and the UK’s leading Balinese gamelan ensemble, Lila Cita. Recorded using bows, prepared techniques, unconventional beaters, and expressive gestures, the sessions reveal new textures while preserving the instruments’ unmistakable acoustic character.

At the heart of the collection is the shimmering phenomenon of ombak, the natural beating created by pairs of instruments tuned just a few hertz apart. Alongside beautifully detailed acoustic recordings, you’ll find carefully crafted processed layers created using modular synthesis, tape saturation, and warm analogue distortion, expanding the palette while remaining rooted in the instrument’s unique voice.

Perfect for cinematic scoring, ambient composition, experimental electronics, and modern sound design, Gamelan Textures offers a fresh perspective on one of the world’s most captivating musical traditions.

ScdNS7E7Hmrd6cWIYc7FD.summary: Wurli is the definitive rendition of the legendary Wurlitzer keyboard. Not only a pillar of RnB classics from Ray Charles to Donny Hathaway, this instrument found its way onto countless hits of the 70s and 80s with Elton John, Richard Carpenter, Edward Van Halen, and famously on Supertramp’s Dreamer. Explore the classic sound reimagined.

1AhalwrRgirx91b3ICu2Fm.name: Originals Felt Piano
1AhalwrRgirx91b3ICu2Fm.summary:
Felt Piano is a delicate, characterful upright performed by jazz legend and Mercury Prize nominee Gwilym Simcock. Recorded dry at Spitfire Studios with soft felt placed between the hammers and strings, every note captures warmth, softness, and control.

This pack includes ten presets ranging from dry and close to spacious and pad-like, offering a full spectrum of felt textures. Whether you’re writing intimate piano lines, scoring emotional scenes, or layering gentle harmonies, Felt Piano delivers a quiet intensity that sits beautifully in any mix.

Subtle. Expressive. Full of soul.

Epic Choir offers instant inspiration for film and TV scoring — featuring various shorts, longs, as well as vowel-blending ‘episodic’ textures, inspired by gothic and mediaeval chanting. Offering a huge dynamic range, seamlessly shift between hauntingly quiet to raucously powerful and sublime. Explore the endless potential of the human voice. 24 distinctive articulations.

7qNTtateQ2VHtYwOaeFG1U.name: Fluid Violin
7qNTtateQ2VHtYwOaeFG1U.summary:
Fluid Phrases is a collection of four expressive legato libraries taken from Spitfire Audio’s Appassionata series—featuring Fluid Violin, Fluid Viola, Fluid Cello, and Fluid Basses. Recorded at the legendary AIR Studios’ Lyndhurst Hall, these libraries capture the next generation of string legatos using Spitfire’s groundbreaking Impulse Legato technique.

Designed for flowing, emotive lines, these instruments deliver perfectly balanced vibrato and stunningly realistic rebowing, allowing composers to write in a soaring, melodic style with effortless realism. Referencing the lyrical aesthetic of film composers like John Williams and Thomas Newman, Fluid Phrases brings an unparalleled level of passion and detail to your compositions—whether you’re crafting cinematic scores, evocative string arrangements, or hybrid soundscapes.

22hbE1Ome1R1n2c7NmWgyq.name: Symphonic Trumpets & Horns
22hbE1Ome1R1n2c7NmWgyq.summary:
Symphonic Trumpets & Horns puts the world’s best brass players at your fingertips. Crafted from the renowned Spitfire Symphony Orchestra library, these recordings capture the expressive detail and orchestral grandeur of world-class musicians performing at AIR Studios’ Lyndhurst Hall.

Elevate your productions with unparalleled realism and dynamics from this expertly sampled selection of sounds, ranging from the delicate to the thunderous. These gold-standard recordings offer a powerful, cinematic palette for everything from soaring, heroic themes to rich, emotional underscoring.

Combine this with Symphonic Trombones & Tuba to bring the elegance and depth of a full symphonic brass section to your compositions.

74vimKSbm9eusPNLnKdkX8.name: Textural Choir
74vimKSbm9eusPNLnKdkX8.summary:
Textural Choir explores the voice not just as a melodic instrument, but as a layered, shifting sound source. Performed by a group of world-class singers and shaped into evolving textures, this pack focuses on breath, tone and motion rather than traditional choral phrasing.

Expect shimmering layers, hushed clouds, and abstract sounds that move and transform under your fingertips. Built for building atmosphere and emotion, Textural Choir is ideal for ambient scoring, experimental pop, or any production that calls for human expression in its most abstract form.

A choir not for harmony, but for texture.

4XdcSDj39ecooq5MkwTqH7.name: Epic Choir
4XdcSDj39ecooq5MkwTqH7.summary: All the power and beauty of the human voice at your fingertips… Our largest choir recorded to date, this highly anticipated library features 50 of London’s finest singers, recorded in two sections (Sopranos & Altos/Tenors & Basses). Epic Choir offers instant inspiration for film and TV scoring — featuring various shorts, longs, as well as vowel-blending ‘episodic’ textures, inspired by gothic and mediaeval chanting. Offering a huge dynamic range, seamlessly shift between hauntingly quiet to raucously powerful and sublime. Explore the endless potential of the human voice. 24 distinctive articulations.

1M6lzlMnf4Obsama8fZNrt.name: Contrast Choir
1M6lzlMnf4Obsama8fZNrt.summary:
Contrast Choir pushes the boundaries of what a choir can be. Curated by Grammy-winning composer and conductor Eric Whitacre, and performed by 19 world-class singers at AIR Studios, this collection explores the voice as a shifting, living texture, moving between harmony and chaos in real time.

At its core are two standout preset styles: Converge and Diverge. Converge begins in dissonance, slowly bending and resolving into pitch. Diverge does the opposite, starting in tune, then pulling apart into atonal, unsettling textures. These evolving performances create tension and release in entirely new ways, making them perfect for sci-fi, horror, and psychological drama.

With rich tone, evolving dynamics, and deeply human unpredictability, Contrast Choir offers a powerful toolkit for composers looking to step outside the traditional choral sound and into something stranger, darker, and more alive.

4XdcSDj39ecooq5MkwTqH7.name: Epic Choir
4XdcSDj39ecooq5MkwTqH7.summary: All the power and beauty of the human voice at your fingertips… Our largest choir recorded to date, this highly anticipated library features 50 of London’s finest singers, recorded in two sections (Sopranos & Altos/Tenors & Basses). Epic Choir offers instant inspiration for film and TV scoring — featuring various shorts, longs, as well as vowel-blending ‘episodic’ textures, inspired by gothic and mediaeval chanting. Offering a huge dynamic range, seamlessly shift between hauntingly quiet to raucously powerful and sublime. Explore the endless potential of the human voice. 24 distinctive articulations.

70de5AL9D95PYkxAWBK6Al.name: Symphonic Ensemble
70de5AL9D95PYkxAWBK6Al.summary:
Symphonic Ensemble gives you the full force of a string section in one playable instrument. Featuring three ensemble presets made up of Violins I and II, Violas, Celli and Basses, this pack is ideal for sketching ideas quickly or composing rich, layered string parts without switching between instruments.

Whether you’re drafting cinematic themes, building emotional beds, or laying down quick arrangements before diving into detailed orchestration, Symphonic Ensemble brings immediacy and depth to your writing process. Lush, balanced, and ready to play straight out of the box.

1Rp0VBaJCx4QznxfJxDJnp.name: Offbeat
1Rp0VBaJCx4QznxfJxDJnp.summary:
Offbeat is an explosive collision of raw materials and rhythm—distorted hits, warped metals, and percussion that feels more industrial than orchestral. This pack doesn’t whisper—it slams.

Expect larger-than-life drums, processed textures, and eclectic loops that rattle, scrape, and punch their way through the mix. It’s chaotic, textural, and deliberately rough around the edges—perfect for producers looking to inject their tracks with percussive grit and mechanical energy.

From cinematic mayhem to left-field club beats, Offbeat is built to make noise. Use with caution.

2R6j147KieDpgUiuiVagdf.name: Symphonic Flutes & Clarinets
2R6j147KieDpgUiuiVagdf.summary:
Symphonic Flutes & Clarinets feature some of Spitfire Audio’s most iconic woodwind sounds. Crafted from the renowned Spitfire Symphony Orchestra library, these recordings capture the expressive detail and orchestral grandeur of world-class musicians performing at AIR Studios’ Lyndhurst Hall.

With a versatile selection of long and short articulations, Symphonic Flutes & Clarinets delivers the essential tools for dynamic and expressive writing. Whether you're scoring for film, TV, or games, or adding orchestral depth to your music, these gold-standard recordings ensure every phrase is performed with authenticity and character.

Combine this with Symphonic Oboes & Bassoons to bring the elegance and depth of a full symphonic section to your compositions.

4XdcSDj39ecooq5MkwTqH7.summary: All the power and beauty of the human voice at your fingertips… Our largest choir recorded to date, this highly anticipated library features 50 of London’s finest singers, recorded in two sections (Sopranos & Altos/Tenors & Basses). Epic Choir offers instant inspiration for film and TV scoring — featuring various shorts, longs, as well as vowel-blending ‘episodic’ textures, inspired by gothic and mediaeval chanting. Offering a huge dynamic range, seamlessly shift between hauntingly quiet to raucously powerful and sublime. Explore the endless potential of the human voice. 24 distinctive articulations.

6Qviy4p6jgaDrN8MbO2tW9.name: Symphonic Violins & Violas
6Qviy4p6jgaDrN8MbO2tW9.summary:
Symphonic Violins & Violas captures some of the world’s finest string players and places them at your disposal. Crafted from the renowned Spitfire Symphony Orchestra library, these recordings capture the expressive detail and orchestral grandeur of world-class musicians performing at AIR Studios’ Lyndhurst Hall.

Add beautiful layers to your music with delicate, long articulations, or add urgency and action with staccato and pizzicato notes. Featuring a versatile selection of professional standard sounds, Symphonic Violins & Violas provides you with the tools you need for expressive and dynamic writing.

eRXrNzuaScmpJUgmdLJFD.name: Symphonic Oboes & Bassoons
eRXrNzuaScmpJUgmdLJFD.summary:
Symphonic Oboes & Bassoons feature some of Spitfire Audio’s most iconic woodwind sounds. Crafted from the renowned Spitfire Symphony Orchestra library, these recordings capture the expressive detail and orchestral grandeur of world-class musicians performing at AIR Studios’ Lyndhurst Hall.

With a versatile selection of long and short articulations, Symphonic Oboes & Bassoons delivers the essential tools for dynamic and expressive writing. Whether you're scoring for film, TV, or games, or adding orchestral depth to your music, these gold-standard recordings ensure every phrase is performed with authenticity and character.

Combine this with Symphonic Flutes & Clarinets to bring the elegance and depth of a full symphonic section to your compositions.

2yNacqYxeX5tSJJwlvr09h.name: Chamber Ensemble
2yNacqYxeX5tSJJwlvr09h.summary:
Chamber Ensemble captures the intimacy and precision of a chamber string section in six easy-to-use presets. Featuring 16 world-class players - four 1st violins, three 2nd violins, three violas, three cellos, and three basses. This is a rich, balanced sound that’s perfect for writing full string parts with immediacy.

Whether you’re sketching themes, building emotional textures, or laying down detailed arrangements, Chamber Ensemble delivers the warmth and clarity of a smaller ensemble with the same cinematic feel.

Ideal for everything from subtle drama to intricate scores. Ready when you are.

38xY7dwQtA8zZk8A9isSkf.name: Fluid Cello
38xY7dwQtA8zZk8A9isSkf.summary:
Fluid Phrases is a collection of four expressive legato libraries taken from Spitfire Audio’s Appassionata series. Recorded at the legendary AIR Studios’ Lyndhurst Hall, these libraries capture the next generation of string legatos using Spitfire’s groundbreaking Impulse Legato technique.

Designed for flowing, emotive lines, these instruments deliver perfectly balanced vibrato and stunningly realistic rebowing, allowing composers to write in a soaring, melodic style with effortless realism.

1fb7e5EaqWp7AZUXiroBnT.name: Fluid Basses
1fb7e5EaqWp7AZUXiroBnT.summary:
Fluid Phrases is a collection of four expressive legato libraries taken from Spitfire Audio’s Appassionata series—featuring Fluid Violin, Fluid Viola, Fluid Cello, and Fluid Basses. Recorded at the legendary AIR Studios’ Lyndhurst Hall, these libraries capture the next generation of string legatos using Spitfire’s groundbreaking Impulse Legato technique.

Designed for flowing, emotive lines, these instruments deliver perfectly balanced vibrato and stunningly realistic rebowing, allowing composers to write in a soaring, melodic style with effortless realism. Referencing the lyrical aesthetic of film composers like John Williams and Thomas Newman, Fluid Phrases brings an unparalleled level of passion and detail to your compositions—whether you’re crafting cinematic scores, evocative string arrangements, or hybrid soundscapes.

7bVuyROYUKLuYJoTw4lAQ7.name: Intimate Synths
7bVuyROYUKLuYJoTw4lAQ7.summary:
Intimate Synths is a collection of soft, close-up synth sounds inspired by the emotional, otherworldly production styles found across modern experimental pop. Built from hardware synths and shaped with outboard effects, these sounds feel personal, detailed, and full of subtle movement.

Inside you’ll find delicate plucks, atmospheric pads, and evolving textures designed to sit close to the listener. Perfect for ambient pop, electronic songwriting, and productions that blur the line between organic and synthetic, Intimate Synths offers a palette that’s gentle, immersive, and quietly expressive.

xW3jJjSIRwWZs5pnkv4t1.name: Ultra Soft Piano
xW3jJjSIRwWZs5pnkv4t1.summary:
Building on the legacy of Soft Piano—our most downloaded LABS pack that helped shape the sound of piano music over the past decade—Ultra Soft Piano reimagines what a piano can be. 

For its sequel, we set out to define the next ten years of piano sounds by asking ourselves: What is the piano we most want to play? The answer led us to create a sound inspired by the piano in the home—the one in the living room by the fire, in the kitchen whilst someone is cooking, or surrounded by friends and family.

77BBFvrCIEkRLn9Qv3VNnu.name: Ultra Soft Electric Piano
77BBFvrCIEkRLn9Qv3VNnu.summary:
Ultra Soft Electric Piano is all about closeness. Recorded at Baltic Studios as a companion to Ultra Soft Piano, we stripped an electric piano down to its bare essentials, removing the case and mic’ing the tines from just inches away. Every detail, every vibration, captured with intimacy.

To add even more character, we re-amped the signal through a vintage amp for subtle warmth and texture. The result is a sound so soft and controlled, it borders on impossible to play naturally.

This is a dream for intimate pop, film scoring, or any moment that calls for delicate, expressive tone. Quiet, tactile, and full of feeling.

20Zl1K9joAgDSRM4BjIiaa.name: Studio Drums
20Zl1K9joAgDSRM4BjIiaa.summary:
Studio Drums is a collection of three expertly crafted kits designed for modern pop production. Recorded at Sound Factory Studios in LA, each kit is built to sit effortlessly in a mix while retaining character and feel.

Choose from a soft Brush Kit for gentle, intimate arrangements, a tight Hyperdead Kit for indie and folk, and a punchy Motown Kit for soul and R&B grooves. Whether you’re sketching ideas or finishing a track, Studio Drums gives you a reliable, great-sounding foundation straight away.

3ZWSApTxrUnlQPqJIuzbap.summary: Eight of London’s finest string players (2,2,0,2,2), performing a selection of experimental playing techniques, at the quietest of levels. 4xQBiZUOlHj2qA0coPV1x.name: Office Machine
4xQBiZUOlHj2qA0coPV1x.summary:
Unfamiliar, otherworldly synths. Unique sound design. Alien-like percussion. Office Machine blends vintage character with modern weirdness for a unique set of experimental sounds that are perfect for leads, basses, and everything in between. Chaotic in the best way, and endlessly fun to play with.

Perfect for those shaping sonics on the fringes, whether you're building moody, minimalist pop like Tirzah or pushing textures into artful noise à la ML Buch, Office Machine gives you a toolkit of playful disorder with cinematic bite.

This pack is a result of what happens when you let curiosity run wild in a room full of instruments, synths, guitar pedals, and even a mini steel pan. Recorded entirely at Spitfire Audio HQ by the LABS+ team, musicians, sound designers, and anyone who felt like jumping in, this eclectic pack is the sound of joyful experimentation and glorious, unexpected mess in all the best ways.

69sCoyzMDFDNeN4c7MoAkZ.summary:
Odd Pianos is a collection of three unconventional pianos, each with its own distinct edge. Featuring a prepared piano, a tack piano, and an industrial piano, this pack is designed for those moments where a regular grand just won’t cut it.

Metallic attacks, nails on the strings and mechanical resonance make these instruments perfect for unsettling textures, eerie atmospheres, or simply adding something raw and unexpected to your sound. Whether you’re scoring tension or pushing boundaries in modern production, Odd Pianos brings the strange in all the right ways.

7dBEPbbaSYEIluy9Zr7qIe.summary:
Lofi Toy Piano takes the innocent charm of a Schoenhut toy piano and drags it through tape hiss, VHS warble, and stuttered FX to create something altogether dirtier.

Crunchy, pitchy and full of character, this is the perfect keys sound for trap, grime, drill and anything that needs a bit of off-kilter attitude. From eerie melodies to glitched-out hooks, it’s playful, unsettling, and weirdly addictive.

Tiny keys. Big energy.

4zaqSyp6McvrTboJZpSLRO.name: John Legend: Ordinary People Piano
4zaqSyp6McvrTboJZpSLRO.summary:
John Legend’s Ordinary People Piano captures the warmth and character of his iconic grand piano, Splice recorded and mixed to echo the sound world of Get Lifted. Using the same studio approach—classic mics, vintage desk, and mix chain—to recreate the soulful tone of one of his most iconic performances.

This is the sound of John Legend. Perfect for pop, soul, R&B, and heartfelt ballads, the instrument includes five presets—Ultra Close, Pop Close, Ribbon Mics, Room Mics, and Ordinary People Piano—so you can shape it to your own production and nail the signature sound.

2SEpQBkPvW713zSkKTLt3f.name: Glitch Vocals
2SEpQBkPvW713zSkKTLt3f.summary:
Glitch Vocals is a collection of warped, reactive vocal sounds built for cutting, modern production. Chopped phrases, fractured tones and digital artefacts twist and shift as you play, giving you sharp, unpredictable textures straight out of the box.

Designed as a companion to Glitch Drums and Glitch Synths, this pack is perfect for choppy dance music, glitchy electronics, sci-fi scoring and experimental pop. Push, bend and break the voice into something entirely new.

dZimtHhz9eWAF6t7NByy0.name: Digital Nostalgia
dZimtHhz9eWAF6t7NByy0.summary:
Digital Nostalgia taps into the sound of the early internet age. Glossy synths, soft digital tones, and that unmistakable late 90s to early 2000s atmosphere. Inspired by the Frutiger Aero aesthetic, screensavers and old operating systems, this pack captures a moment where digital felt new, bright and full of possibility.

Recorded on analogue synths and shaped by our sound designers, these sounds balance warmth with a polished, synthetic edge. Perfect for nostalgic pop, ambient textures, or adding a subtle retro-futurist feel to modern productions.

56SSuz28zq20KoJBQY2yB6.name: Cinemagnetic
56SSuz28zq20KoJBQY2yB6.summary:
Cinemagnetic is a deep dive into the sound world of Amulets, master of cassette loops, live-processed guitars, and decaying analogue textures. Built from the exact tools he uses on stage and in the studio: handmade tape loops, boutique synths, FX pedals, and even a stylophone. This pack captures the beauty of sound breaking apart in real time.

Inside you’ll find lush synths that drift from fragile leads to guttural basses, alongside immersive drones that evolve, glitch, and dissolve. It’s ambient music with grit and grain, perfect for crafting cinematic soundscapes, experimental textures, or adding lo-fi weight to electronic productions.

This is texture-first sound design. Raw, imperfect, and endlessly playable.

24dygB4Id7OCDdGNH93dyS.name: Boombox FM
24dygB4Id7OCDdGNH93dyS.summary:
Boombox FM is a collaboration with sound designer and electronic artist Robinson’s Village, built around a simple idea taken to its limits. A range of synth pads, keys and sound design patches were fed through an old boombox speaker via a Bluetooth receiver, capturing all the grit, distortion and unpredictability of the signal chain.

The result is a lo-fi, unstable sound world filled with radio static, degraded tones and fragments of chatter that drift in and out of focus. It’s textured, imperfect and full of character.

Perfect for sound designers, experimental producers and anyone looking to push their palette into stranger territory, Boombox FM brings a raw, off-grid energy to your music.

lN1aSTBdyXjZltRQvE6tk.name: Astral Forms
lN1aSTBdyXjZltRQvE6tk.summary:
An ethereal collection of sounds created with vocals, double bass, electric guitar, saxophones and more. Performed by a talented group of musicians and sculpted by the Spitfire Audio team, these range from beautiful and beguiling, to dark and atmospheric — perfect for adding depth and character to your scores.

Made in collaboration with the charity Abram Wilson — an organisation dedicated to providing equal opportunities for underrepresented talent in the music industry.

Sounds by: Naima Adams · Emma Johnson · Plumm · Sans Soucis · David Austin Grey · Daniel Kemshell · Joe Downard · Shereece Storrod.

Known for his cutting-edge approach to the violin, 4STRINGSZ transforms this classical instrument into a modern force - with the help of the Yamaha SV250 electric violin and advanced sound design techniques.

Each sound has a unique processed effect controlled via the Dynamics slider, providing endless possibilities to switch up your music. Whether you're producing drill, grime, or hip-hop, or seeking hybrid textures as a composer or sound designer, this pack pushes boundaries and redefines the role of the violin in contemporary music.

5O9c0Q5iRBjN88xya4QHh7.name: Glitch Drums
5O9c0Q5iRBjN88xya4QHh7.summary:
Rhythm, but not as you know it. Glitch Drums is a next-gen collection of drum kits and loops that twist, stutter, and trip over themselves in real time. Drawing from the wonky chaos of ’90s IDM and the surgically precise glitching of 2020s experimental electronic music, every preset is processed to give you that unpredictable, sound design heavy feel.

The modwheel is your glitch switch—move it and hear your drum beats collapse into stuttering fills, digital hiccups, and warped, time-stretched percussion. No painstaking edits, no overcooked automation—just instant, controlled mayhem. Whether you’re crafting hyper-detailed club bangers, left-field electronica, or experimental sound design, Glitch Drums brings that restless, forward-thinking energy straight to your music.

5BAO4zxsEwF34b1O6lGoDV.summary:
Unleash intergalactic travel with Sci-Fi Pads - lush, layered textures designed to pull your music into distant galaxies. Built from warped and mangled orchestral recordings, then twisted through analogue gear, this pack balances cinematic depth with experimental grit.

Inside you’ll find eerie drones, dystopian ambiences, and shimmering pads that feel both vast and claustrophobic - perfect for scoring the unknown, imagining new worlds, or just adding strange beauty to your sound palette.

Whether you're crafting brooding sci-fi scores, glitch-heavy electronica, or ambient dreamscapes, Sci-Fi Pads gives you the tools to build sonic landscapes that feel tactile, emotional, and just a bit unhinged.

Soul Vocals is a collection of rich male and female vocal textures designed to elevate your productions into something more atmospheric and emotive. Featuring long, expressive vowel sounds, these vocals go beyond traditional soul, blending seamlessly into RnB, electronic, ambient, and cinematic work.

Push the dynamics and you’ll uncover a top layer of dreamy, granular processing that adds an ethereal, almost otherworldly tone.

From grounded warmth to floating vocal haze, Soul Vocals gives you a versatile palette of human expression, reimagined through texture and tone.

2DMQ8eeBsNDFbygFm9X9vH.summary: Made in collaboration with award-winning composer Hannah Peel, LABS Uilleann pipes features in her score for the National Theatre production of ‘Dancing at Lughnasa’. Also known as the Irish Bagpipe, Uilleann pipes utilise multiple drones, regulators and chanters to produce acres of sonic possibilities. Performed with traditional Celtic flourishes and ornamentations, this rarely sampled instrument provides an unconventional way to add texture and interest to contemporary music.

6C0ZBA0bKgXDJQBRelJ4SV.name: Unheard London
6C0ZBA0bKgXDJQBRelJ4SV.summary:
Unheard London is the city beneath the surface. Using EMF and contact microphones, we captured the hidden sonic layers of central London - the electromagnetic hum of pylons and e-bikes, the vibrations of tube railings, the resonance of the metal bridges.

These are sounds you can’t hear with the naked ear. Industrial textures. Electric murmurs. The pulse of a modern city reimagined as synth and noise.

Built into a playable toolkit of glitchy textures and mechanical tones, Unheard London is perfect for hyperpop, experimental electronics, and raw, dystopian scoring. It’s the London underworld. Unfiltered, unpredictable, and buzzing with strange energy.

Indie Baritone Guitar is a collection of woozy, 80s-tinged electric baritone textures. Dreamy, dark, and dripping with character. Inspired by alt-pop pioneers like Mk.Gee, these guitars have been processed through tape, VHS artefacts, and deep, moody reverbs to give them a hazy, nostalgic edge.

From saturated plucks to long, smeared sustains, each preset reacts to the modwheel with shifting tone, pitch, and texture. Gritty, unpredictable, and full of soul.

Perfect for alt-pop, ambient, or anything that lives in the space between analogue warmth and digital decay.

1mXNbnOQpW8MzA2RPKkl6O.summary:
Created in collaboration with some of the OPIA artists performing at the 2024 OPIA festival (Utrecht, 2nd June), we asked the artists to provide a sound on the theme of ‘travelling’ - from sounds of the rainforest to a Balinese Gamelan used in Kiasmos’ latest album - which we then pulled, stretched and mangled into 13 unique and wandering presets.

Featuring sounds from: Davidsson, Eydís Evensen, Kiasmos, Lara Somogyi, Martijn Naber, Robin Scherpen, Sandrayati, Shida Shahabi, Sofi Paez, Svaneborg Kardyb, Zuzanna Całka.

5lGrDo78FDONZUS1eyXTaE.name: Latin Percussion
5lGrDo78FDONZUS1eyXTaE.summary:
Latin Percussion is a vibrant collection of six expertly performed instruments, featuring Bongos, Cajon, Conga, Quinto, Timbale, and Tumba. Played by award winning percussionist Reinaldo Dejesus, this pack captures the energy and nuance of authentic Latin rhythms in a deeply playable form.

Every hit and phrase carries Reinaldo’s unique touch, blending precision with feel. Whether you’re adding subtle grooves or building bold, rhythmic foundations, Latin Percussion brings warmth, movement, and character to any genre—from film scoring to contemporary production.

casBH52VsGNLj0dZ8bpag.name: Odyssey Bowed
casBH52VsGNLj0dZ8bpag.summary:
Odyssey Bowed features three traditional instruments originating from the East Mediterranean region - the Classical Kemençe, Thracian Lyra, and Cretan Lyra & Sympathetic Lyra, expertly recorded and processed by the talented Dimitris Kordis. This selection of bowed string instruments has a rich history that evokes mythological grandeur with intimate detail.

Inside you’ll find mellow, melancholic sound palettes with rich, harmonic articulations to offer untold versatility. Bend these sounds to your will with microtonal trills, progressive sustains, and dynamic fluctuations to add complex and unique sonic textures to your music.

Whether you're crafting widescreen drama, experimental electronica, or textured folk-inspired work, Odyssey Bowed gives you access to a sound world that’s both timeless, expressive, and quietly epic.

1milGZ85UIKhtBs33AHJc7.name: Gaelic Voices
1milGZ85UIKhtBs33AHJc7.summary: Six traditional Gaelic singers recorded inside the ruins of a 1960s seminary. Originally a training campus for catholic priests, St Peter’s Seminary shut down in 1980 and fell into disrepair. In the concrete skeleton of the former chapel, the LABS team captured a small group of singers performing a captivating range of aleatoric techniques, inspired by Celtic vocal traditions.

59FZla9dQNxADdZQazbm3R.name: Electronic Antique
59FZla9dQNxADdZQazbm3R.summary:
Discover a rare gem of music history with one of the world's earliest synthesisers — the Ondioline. Designed and patented by French inventor Georges Jenny in the early 1940s, the LABS team captured its delightfully off-kilter sound, transforming the raw recordings into a range of playful presets. Fizzing with smile-inducing possibilities — the Ondioline is as wild as your imagination.

Special thanks to Forgotten Futures for archive material and resources. Ondioline restored by Daniel Kitzig.

48ZMOUXFQRtSodinUm1FRV.name: Star Coda
48ZMOUXFQRtSodinUm1FRV.summary:
Star Coda is a collaboration with composer Jetdarc, winner of the Esports World Cup scoring competition held with Audiotool. Together, we took over Abbey Road Studios to capture a selection of analogue synths, then pushed them into new territory with glitchy, stuttered processing and layered FX chains.

The result is a collection of eerie, unstable tones built for modern video game scoring. Think tense menus, liminal dream sequences, corrupted landscapes. Every sound is sculpted to feel slightly off-centre, slightly broken, and full of atmosphere.

Perfect for composers working in sci-fi, horror, or anything that lives in the space between worlds.

4Co1r7R5rclTqKwxUiJXT.name: Tokyo Atmos
4Co1r7R5rclTqKwxUiJXT.summary: Tokyo Atmos is an exploration of movement, texture and urban space. Recorded across Japan, this pack draws from streets, parks, trains and passing voices, capturing the everyday sound of Tokyo in motion. These field recordings were chopped, stretched and reshaped, stuttered vocal fragments layered with evolving ambient pads derived from the city’s harmonic noise using granular processing and detailed manipulation. At its core is the Dynamic Slider: push forward to introduce layered vocal chops against the pads, or pull back for more spacious, immersive tones. The result is a collection of shifting, human textures, restless, atmospheric and ideal for contemporary scoring or electronic production.

49E34r0Sw7IchO8tCHTudL.name: Lofi Folk
49E34r0Sw7IchO8tCHTudL.summary:
Lofi Folk is a collection of soft, characterful instruments shaped for modern folk-pop and introspective songwriting. Featuring acoustic guitar, mandolin, electric piano, ukulele banjo, and hazy synths, it’s a sound palette built for warm, slightly wonky arrangements in the spirit of experimental folk and lofi tape recordings.

Move the dynamics slider to introduce gentle tape hiss and warmth across the board. Perfect for giving your tracks that lived-in, nostalgic feel. Whether you’re writing quiet songs or building textured, acoustic-led productions, Lofi Folk brings a sense of space, softness and soul.

59PvYSLhpwHwqhWDUPsL7i.summary: During the 2020 pandemic, cinematic pop quartet Sons of Serendip found themselves unable to perform. Turning their talents to sampling, lead arranger Cordaro Rodriguez and vocalist Micah Christian recorded a breathtaking collection of vocal performances — channelling heartache and emotion into every note.

4XdcSDj39ecooq5MkwTqH7.name: Epic Choir
4XdcSDj39ecooq5MkwTqH7.summary: All the power and beauty of the human voice at your fingertips… Our largest choir recorded to date, this highly anticipated library features 50 of London’s finest singers, recorded in two sections (Sopranos & Altos/Tenors & Basses). Epic Choir offers instant inspiration for film and TV scoring — featuring various shorts, longs, as well as vowel-blending ‘episodic’ textures, inspired by gothic and mediaeval chanting. Offering a huge dynamic range, seamlessly shift between hauntingly quiet to raucously powerful and sublime. Explore the endless potential of the human voice. 24 distinctive articulations.

Inside you’ll find gritty drums, warped pads, lofi loops - all buzzing with a strange, future-facing energy. It’s dark. It’s glitchy. It’s nostalgic. But a sense of playfulness constantly lingers beneath the surface with a mischievous edge.

Dream Fragments is a toolkit for producers chasing that hazy in-between space - somewhere between beat tape and sci-fi score, between club music and audio collage.

1ZpqnzyUXgcRFP3VPJmzIz.name: Digital Memory
1ZpqnzyUXgcRFP3VPJmzIz.summary:
Old tech, future sound. Digital Memory is a deep dive into the singular world of legendary electronic artist Nathan Fake, who bends outdated hardware to his will, crafting hyper-modern club music on an early 2000s machine. Shaped through a workflow that’s remained unchanged for decades—this pack captures the raw, hands-on process behind his signature sound: gritty saws, pure sine waves, and metallic FM synths, from drifting pads to sharp, percussive plucks—perfect for sculpting everything from propulsive techno to off-kilter electronica.

It's anachronistic innovation at its finest—an artist squeezing every last drop from an ageing system to create music that sounds like tomorrow. Whether you’re pushing the edges of dance music or exploring new sonic territories, Digital Memory gives you direct access to a workflow frozen in time, yet always moving forward.

5AFVYB5MpzMqSSTRZ0cWUj.summary:
Glitch Synths is a chaotic collection of mangled, reactive synths that twist, stutter and break apart in real time. Push the dynamics slider and things get weird fast. Warped modulation, tonal shifts, and unexpected textures evolve with every movement.
Built by the LABS team using raw synths, field recordings, and even voice notes, this pack is deliberately unpredictable. From glitched-out leads to flickering pads, Glitch Synths is perfect for experimental electronics, left-field pop, or anything that needs a touch of beautiful instability.
Pairs perfectly with Glitch Drums. Use both and embrace the glitch.

6UleLxTbUIyxFTiNhDOiXD.name: Gong Textures
6UleLxTbUIyxFTiNhDOiXD.summary:
Gong Textures is an exploration of resonance, noise and transformation. Recorded at the beautifully resonant Pool Studios, this pack features a range of gongs including an 80” tam tam, pitched Thai gongs, a 28” wind gong, a 38" symphonic gong and a Chinese opera gong, all played using experimental techniques including using cello bows and a variety of beaters.

We captured every shimmer and scrape using both traditional and contact mics, even re-amping synths through a Leslie speaker placed behind the gongs to excite hidden resonances. These recordings were then pulled apart and reassembled using granular processing and audio manipulation to create entirely new textures.

The result is a set of evolving, abstract sounds. Deep, metallic and sometimes eerie. Perfect for ambient work, experimental scoring, or adding rich, organic layers to electronic productions. A sound world that moves, breathes and hums with tension.

Dark Fantasy draws from the online wave of surreal, dark fantasy imagery. Soft-focus worlds, mythic ruins, and dreamlike scenes that feel nostalgic for something that never existed. It’s that strange mix of beauty and unease, familiar but unreachable.



Built around woozy, dreamlike synths, these sounds drift through chorus, reverb and subtle modulation to create a hazy, unreal atmosphere. Textures blur, tones bend, and everything feels slightly out of time.



Perfect for ambient work, experimental pop or cinematic scoring, Dark Fantasy gives you a palette that sits between memory and imagination.

62H13TEl4bKi9NfQNpOCU3.name: 80s Digital Piano
62H13TEl4bKi9NfQNpOCU3.summary:
80s Digital Piano brings back the iconic sound of classic digital keys. Instantly recognisable, endlessly versatile. Heard across decades of pop, R&B and electronic music, this is the sound of glassy chords, shimmering melodies, and nostalgic soul.

We’ve taken the original tone and pushed it further, adding VHS wobble, tape saturation, chorus and delay. All mapped to the modwheel for expressive control on the fly.

Perfect for alt-pop, moody R&B, or scoring moments that need a little retro-futurist sparkle.

32bddlL31Raf5yljqw1AKC.name: Liminal Hotel
32bddlL31Raf5yljqw1AKC.summary:
Liminal Hotel is a collaboration with London-based artist Léa Sen and her brother and long-time co-producer Florian Fourlin. Inspired by the sound world of her debut album LEVELS, this collection captures the intimate, dreamlike textures that define her music - processed acoustic guitars, hazy saxophone, woozy synths and detailed drums, each touched with the same subtle distortion, liminal space and depth heard across the record.

Made from the ground up in close collaboration with Léa and Florian, these sounds reflect the shared language they’ve built over years of making music together. Soft, smudged, and emotionally loaded, this pack is perfect for alt-pop, minimal electronics, or scoring moments that sit between clarity and blur.

Liminal Hotel is less a place, more a feeling - of transition, memory, and the quiet in-between. Step inside.
